## 2026-09-19 — Claims, payment and evidence-chain operating systems

### Emmanuelok/procore-ultimate — STRONG / MASTER REFERRAL — 30/30
- URL: https://github.com/Emmanuelok/procore-ultimate
- Exact inspected revision: `11baa0855c36d484ee52a93091b14fc2f0451a46`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-19
- Category: Repository / Reusable Component / Business Opportunity
- Concrete capability: `ConstructOS`, a very large construction delivery + owner-assurance system spanning drawing revision supersession/calibration, IFC/CDE state, RFIs/submittals/daily logs/punch, BoQ provenance and rate build-ups, valuations, variations, standard-form contract clause logic, live notice time bars, statutory payment regimes, CPM/forensics, delay/EOT claims, prolongation, cause-effect-entitlement-quantum claims workspaces, permits/programme blockers, payment/insurance/bond obligations, append-only evidence/reconciliation primitives, Merkle evidence packs and independent evidence streams. The inspected head contains 33 API modules, 153 tables and an 870-test suite according to the repository's own verification section.
- Rare or undernoticed value: This is the first public system found in this lane that unifies most of ScopeSignal's remaining post-detection gaps in one coherent state model: notice served method/reference/timestamp, missed time bars, variation/valuation state, EOT/claim lifecycle, independent evidence reconciliation, cost/payment consequences and realized procedural outcomes. It is much closer to a construction commercial-assurance OS than a generic Procore clone.
- Buyer/problem: Owners, GCs/EPCs, claims/commercial teams and lenders need to know whether a change is timely, evidenced, contractually live, procedurally valid and economically reflected rather than merely detected.
- Likely first paid wedge: fixed-price Change/Payment Assurance Audit on one live authorized project: ingest current contract/change/payment records, identify missed/at-risk notice events, unsupported variations/valuations, over-certification or unreconciled evidence, and return a human-reviewed dollar/exposure register.
- Monetization: high-value audit/implementation -> recurring construction commercial-assurance SaaS/managed service -> embedded owner/GC controls.
- Build-time/data advantage: extremely high; likely 6-12+ months of construction-commercial domain/schema/control compression if the implementation proves internally consistent under held-out testing.
- Evidence inspected: exact head commit and its commit message restoring read-path time-bar/permit/grievance/land sweeps; root `README.md`; `apps/api/src/modules/contracts/sweeps.ts` search evidence; architecture/data-model/security search hits; root package metadata. The architecture explicitly records served notice method/reference/timestamp, marks elapsed open events `time_barred`, breaches linked obligations and raises one-time signals; EOT lifecycle is documented as notified -> submitted -> assessed onward.
- Actual public license / rights: root package metadata says `private: true`, `license: UNLICENSED`; no root LICENSE was found. User's standing assertion of separate commercial permission is the working authorization for repository-owned code/content. IMPORTANT separate diligence: FIDIC/NEC/JCT or other standard-form text, carbon-factor data, vendor APIs/connectors, standards/specifications and any third-party datasets/assets are not covered by that assertion and must be independently licensed/verified. The repo itself flags seeded carbon factors as indicative rather than a licensed dataset.
- Score: A5 / B5 / C5 / D5 / E5 / F5 = 30/30 under the standing commercial-permission assumption for repository-owned code. This score does not extend rights to third-party standards/data/services.
- Combination opportunities: strongest current unification target for ScopeSignal: Massing/CaD-Track/BIMChange/OpenTakeoff detection -> BCF identity -> contract-deadline evidence -> ConstructOS notice/variation/EOT/payment/assurance state -> cpp-cpm independent forensic check -> realized payment/claim outcome. It also supplies an owner-side assurance challenger to Prova/BuildSuite contractor-side recovery.
- Next action: do NOT wholesale-trust the breadth. Build a held-out conformance pack for five money-critical invariants: (1) amendment/particular-condition supersession authority, (2) notice served before/after deadline, (3) variation approval before contract-sum mutation, (4) EOT cause-effect-entitlement-quantum trace, (5) certified/payment/retainage outcome. Promote specific modules only when their tests and state transitions survive those cases.

### kushagarwal231-ai/beam — STRONG / MASTER REFERRAL — 27/30
- URL: https://github.com/kushagarwal231-ai/beam
- Exact inspected revision: `8ee869331a22cc3970078544452c9d904be847f0`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-19
- Category: Repository / Reusable Component / Business Opportunity
- Concrete capability: construction pay-application intelligence engine for AIA-style G702/G703 workflows. `SmartValidationService` deterministically compares a current pay app against original contract/SOV baseline, all prior applications, approved change orders, lien-waiver history and insurance. It checks contract/CO totals, SOV mismatch/unauthorized additions, arithmetic, >100% billing, backwards progress, >25% progress spikes, front-loading, sequence, retainage/compliance, conditional-vs-current and unconditional-vs-previous-payment waiver logic, and returns APPROVE/REVIEW/REJECT recommendations. The repo includes real FastAPI models/routes/services plus sample G702/G703/waiver/ACORD artifacts and 4 seeded projects/12 pay apps.
- Rare or undernoticed value: It closes a post-approval dollar-leakage gap that revision/takeoff engines do not: whether approved scope and contract value are being billed correctly, whether the current application drifts from the authoritative SOV, and whether payment prerequisites are actually present.
- Buyer/problem: GCs/owners routinely spend hours per pay app reconciling SOV, approved COs, prior certified amounts, retainage, waivers and insurance; mistakes become direct overpayment or payment delay.
- Likely first paid wedge: read-only Pay App Leakage Audit for one billing cycle: compare customer-authorized pay apps against baseline SOV + approved CO register + prior certs + waivers, quantify dollars requiring hold/review and produce line-level reasons.
- Monetization: per-pay-app audit -> managed monthly review -> recurring owner/GC payment-assurance SaaS.
- Build-time/data advantage: high; compresses months of construction billing domain modeling, validation rules, document schema and review UI/API plumbing.
- Evidence inspected: exact commit; recursive tree with substantive pay-app/project APIs, models, extraction/processing/validation services; `README.md`; `backend/app/services/smart_validation.py`. Source inspection confirmed the context includes original contract, SOV, approved COs, prior apps, last payment and insurance expiry, and that all rule groups are called by the validator. No substantive automated test suite was found via code search at this revision, which limits evidence score.
- Actual public license / rights: README states `Proprietary - All rights reserved`. User's standing assertion supplies separate commercial permission for repository-owned code/content. AIA form trademarks/form copyrights and sample third-party document content are separately governed and should not be assumed licensed by the repository permission.
- Score: A5 / B5 / C5 / D4 / E4 / F4 = 27/30. Fast revenue and direct dollar control are excellent; E/F stop short of 5 because automated invariant tests were not found and third-party form/document provenance remains separate.
- Combination opportunities: ScopeSignal/Prova/BuildSuite establish approved change value; Beam becomes the downstream pre-certification gate that verifies the new contract/SOV/payment state and waiver/retainage prerequisites before money leaves. Owner-side pair with co-ver creates change-order + pay-app leakage assurance.
- Next action: construct a synthetic but accounting-exact benchmark with approved/unapproved COs, SOV drift, duplicate line additions, prior-cert mismatches, retainage release, conditional/unconditional waiver edge cases and final payment; require zero false assertions of recoverable/withholdable dollars when authority is missing.

### DerrickLV/tessera-os — STRONG — 26/30
- URL: https://github.com/DerrickLV/tessera-os
- Exact inspected revision: `c71e3faf6f14d296350f73f41244b353d28bb2be`
- Date inspected: 2026-09-19
- Category: Repository / Reusable Component / Control Architecture
- Concrete capability: evidence-first development/construction operating system with approved baselines, stage gates, entitlement/permit matrices, contract clause comparison with exact locations and counsel-review queues, and a Construction Manager that models schedule milestones, cost codes, RFIs/submittals/tracking, change exposures and safety evidence. `src/tessera_os/construction.py` validates that every milestone/cost/tracking/change/safety item cites known evidence, enforces tenant/project scope, calculates baseline-vs-forecast schedule variance, budget-vs-forecast cost variance, remaining cost and open change exposure, and routes drafts to qualified human review rather than external action.
- Rare or undernoticed value: Excellent pattern for fail-closed evidence + human authorization around commercial/schedule assertions. It treats missing evidence, scope boundaries and review roles as first-class controls rather than bolting citations onto an AI summary.
- Buyer/problem: Owners/developers/CMs need decision dashboards whose schedule/cost/change numbers remain traceable to authorized source evidence and do not silently cross project/client boundaries.
- Likely first paid wedge: controls/readiness implementation around an existing ScopeSignal evidence packet: cited cost/change dashboard + human review queue + project isolation rather than autonomous claim issuance.
- Monetization: implementation/advisory -> recurring internal project-controls/assurance workspace.
- Build-time/data advantage: high control-plane compression, especially evidence schemas, isolation, review queues and deterministic variance calculations.
- Evidence inspected: exact commit; `README.md`; code search for construction change exposure; full `src/tessera_os/construction.py`. Source inspection confirmed citation validation, project authorization, deterministic change exposure = sum(open forecast-approved), and review-only output.
- Actual public license / rights: README says Proprietary; repository-owned code is covered by the user's separate commercial-permission assertion. External Microsoft/OpenAI/vendor services and any independently owned clause/standard content remain separately governed.
- Score: A4 / B4 / C5 / D4 / E5 / F4 = 26/30. Strong evidence/control architecture; narrower direct revenue leakage mechanics than ConstructOS/Beam.
- Combination opportunities: wrap ScopeSignal's revision/quantity/contract findings in Tessera-style evidence validation/project scope/reviewer controls; use ConstructOS/Prova/BuildSuite for deeper commercial state.
- Next action: challenge it with superseded contract amendments and conflicting evidence; require fail-closed output until the controlling authority is explicitly resolved.

### Run synthesis
- Highest-value discovery: `Emmanuelok/procore-ultimate` / ConstructOS. It materially changes the ScopeSignal search frontier because it contains notice delivery/time-bar state, variation/payment rules, EOT/claims forensics and independent evidence reconciliation in one tested construction-commercial OS.
- Strongest near-term paid wedge: Beam owner/GC pay-app leakage audit, because it can quantify overbilling/SOV/waiver/compliance exceptions without requiring full revision-detection deployment.
- New end-to-end target: revision/field trigger -> quantity delta -> controlling contract/amendment -> notice served/received -> cost/schedule causation -> variation/EOT decision -> approved contract value -> pay app/retainage/waiver -> certified/paid outcome. ConstructOS should be treated as a challenge oracle/module source, not automatically trusted wholesale.
